name: Coefficient-Space Connectivity from Directed Girth
statement: If a finite loopless digraph has directed girth $g$, then $\mathcal Z(G)$ is $(g-3)$-connected; it is contractible when $G$ is acyclic. Every coefficient space from the oriented simple bipartite construction is simply connected, and the $(g-3)$ bound is attained on consistently directed even cycles.
proof: Every removed cycle diagonal has codimension at least $g-1$. General position cones sphere maps away from a finite union of linear subspaces of that codimension. The arrangement product transfers the bound, and one directed cycle leaves the complement of the full diagonal, with sphere type $S^{g-2}$.
